source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> Memory Setting -> Correctable Threshold (Inaccurate) EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> Memory Setting -> Time Window (Inaccurate) 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>mc.dimminfo() >>>ei.injectMemError(socket, channel, dimm, sub_channel,rank=0, errType="ce") 6. Check the correctable error increase 7. Inject correctable error several times but not reach the Threshold 8. Release the system >>>go 9. Wait time windows pass 10. Check the correctable error count 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. Correctable error count should be reduced when time windows pass. 2. The system should work normally 3. BMC error log should record which slot has DIMM correctable error 4. The Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 5. Corresponding DIMM lightpath will not light if there is one 6. uEFI SEL Log should record which slot has a DIMM correctable error if there is one

test_case.test_name: Memory controller 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Prove that each approved memory controller's correctable-error leaky bucket increments below threshold and then decays by the specified amount after the configured time window, without service loss or fault-light assertion.
required_package: Authoritative threshold, time-window units and counter-decay algorithm/source
ITP/CScripts build/hash and injectMemError CE semantics
Approved injection count/margin/timing and BMC/UEFI/indicator/health oracle
Dedicated-SUT approval, abort, recovery and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: The FAE supplies authoritative threshold/window semantics, maps the controller target and chooses a bounded CE count with margin below threshold. Pre-count, each injection timestamp, post-injection count and post-window count are captured from the same counter source, then correlated with slot logs, indicators and system health before restoration.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Correctable error count should be reduced when time windows pass. 2. The system should work normally 3. BMC error log should record which slot has DIMM correctable error 4. The Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 5. Corresponding DIMM lightpath will not light if there is one 6. uEFI SEL Log should record which slot has a DIMM correctable error if there is one

Record counter baseline without clearing historical evidence

Target matrix, package hash and exact bounded count
